name: duration-formatter-naming
goal: Helpers use names that explain their transformation; formatDuration replaces audioDuration without changing time formatting

evidence: The existing numeric formatter is pure and reused by three components, but its audioDuration name obscures formatting. The old name predates the recent helper review; that review checked eligibility without assessing naming. Before screenshot: /tmp/harness-duration-naming-before.png

Existing packages/reports/test/utils/evidence-media.test.ts covered media types and two formatted results but no export naming or invalid values. Strengthened the same test to require formatDuration and retain output/invalid-input behavior; this is the normal Vitest suite guard.
